weeks.title: Data Visualisation and Storytelling with Evidence
weeks.summary: Is week aap sawal ke hisaab se sahi chart chunna, visual encodings ki accuracy, colour palettes aur accessibility, misleading charts ko pehchaanna (truncated axis, area scaling, lie factor), aur insight ko ek saaf, annotated kahani ki tarah present karna seekhoge.
concepts: **Sawal se chart**: pehle tay karo ki chart kaunsa sawal answer kar raha hai. Categories ki tulna: bar chart (sorted, horizontal agar labels lambe hon). Time ke saath trend: line chart. Distribution: histogram ya box plot. Do numeric variables ka relationship: scatter plot. Part-to-whole: kam categories ho to stacked bar ya (2-3 slices tak) pie. Kai groups ko ek jaise compare karna ho to small multiples (same axes wale chhote charts ki grid).

**Encodings ki accuracy**: insaan values ko sabse sahi common scale par position se padhte hain, phir length, phir angle/slope, phir area, aur sabse kam sahi colour intensity se. Isliye exact tulna ke liye bar ya dot plot pie aur bubble se behtar hai. Colour ko categories alag karne ya ek highlight ke liye use karo, precise values padhwane ke liye nahi.

**Axes ke rules**: bar chart length se value dikhata hai, isliye uska value axis zero se shuru hona chahiye; truncated axis chhote fark ko bahut bada dikhata hai. Line chart position aur slope dikhata hai, isliye uska axis data ki range par zoom kar sakta hai, bas clearly label ho. Dual y-axis wale charts mein do scales manmarzi se align karke koi bhi 'correlation' dikhaya ja sakta hai, isliye inse bacho ya bahut saavdhaani se use karo.

**Colour palettes**: sequential (halke se gehre ek hue mein) ordered values ke liye, jaise population density; diverging (do hues, beech mein neutral) jab ek meaningful midpoint ho, jaise 0% change ya target; categorical (alag-alag hues) unordered groups ke liye, aur zyada se zyada 6-8 categories. Rainbow palette ordered data ke liye kharab hai kyunki uski brightness evenly nahi badhti aur woh nakli boundaries banata hai.

**Accessibility**: kaafi log red-green colour difference theek se nahi dekh paate, isliye sirf red vs green par meaning mat tikao; colour-blind-safe palettes (jaise blue-orange) use karo aur colour ke saath doosra cue bhi do: direct labels, markers, line styles. Text aur background ka contrast achha rakho, font size padhne layak rakho, aur important chart ke saath alt text ya ek line ka summary do.

**Misleading graphics aur lie factor**: area ya volume se value dikhane par size galat scale karna aam jaal hai: value double karne ke liye circle ka radius double karoge to area 4 guna ho jaata hai; sahi tareeka radius ko √2 guna karna hai. Lie factor = (graphic mein dikhaya gaya effect) ÷ (data mein asal effect); 1 ke paas hona imaandaar chart hai. Cherry-picked time range, bina label ke axes, 3D effects aur inconsistent intervals bhi galat impression dete hain.

**Storytelling**: chart ka title insight bataye ('Q3 mein returns 40% badhe, mostly size issues se'), sirf topic nahi ('Returns by quarter'). Ek chart mein ek main message, highlight colour sirf us par, baaki grey; zaroori points par annotation; clutter (heavy gridlines, borders, 3D, legend jab direct labels ho sakte hain) hatao. Audience ke hisaab se detail chuno, aur caveats (data ki seemayein, sample size) saaf likho.

example.problem: Ek (kalpanik) company ka dashboard dikhata hai: 'Customer satisfaction 96% se 98% hua', bar chart mein y-axis 95 se shuru hota hai aur doosra bar pehle se 3 guna lamba dikhta hai. Is chart ko critique karo aur sudhaaro.
steps: Bar chart value ko length se dikhata hai, isliye axis 0 se shuru hona chahiye. Yahan axis 95 se shuru hai.
Dikhne wali lengths: 96 − 95 = 1 aur 98 − 95 = 3, isliye doosra bar 3 guna lamba lagta hai.
Asal ratio 98 / 96 ≈ 1.02, yaani sirf lagbhag 2% zyada (2 percentage points).
Dikhaya gaya effect: (3 − 1) / 1 = 200% badhotri; data mein effect: (98 − 96) / 96 ≈ 2.08%. Lie factor ≈ 200 / 2.08 ≈ 96, jo 1 se bahut door hai.

Sudhaar: bar chart ka axis 0 se, ya agar chhota change hi focus hai to zero baseline wali bars ke saath change ko direct label karo ('+2 pts'), ya time ke saath trend ho to line chart jismein axis range clearly label ho.
Answer: **truncated axis ne ~2% badhotri ko 3 guna jaisa dikhaya**; zero-based axis aur direct label se chart imaandaar banta hai.

mistakes: Bar chart ka y-axis zero ke bajaye data ke minimum se shuru karna. Chhota fark bahut bada dikhta hai. Fix: bars ke liye zero baseline; zoom chahiye to line ya dot plot use karo aur axis clearly label karo.

Saari categories ko ek se ek chamakdaar rang de dena. Kuch bhi highlight nahi hota aur colour-blind readers ke liye categories mil jaati hain. Fix: neutral grey + ek highlight colour, colour-blind-safe palette, aur direct labels.
Chart ka title sirf topic rakhna ('Sales by region'). Reader ko khud insight dhoondhna padta hai. Fix: title mein takeaway likho aur use support karne wale point ko annotate karo.
revision: Comparison: bar; trend: line; distribution: histogram/box; relationship: scatter.
Accuracy: position > length > angle > area > colour intensity.
Bar chart axis zero se; line chart zoom kar sakta hai.
Sequential ordered ke liye, diverging midpoint ke liye, categorical groups ke liye.
Area scaling: value ×2 ⇒ radius ×√2; lie factor ≈ 1 ho.
Title = insight; ek chart, ek message; red-green par mat tiko.

questions.question: Aapko do products ki monthly revenue 24 mahinon ke liye dikhani hai, taaki trend aur seasonality dikhe. Sabse uchit chart kaunsa hai?
options: Line chart, har product ki ek line, x-axis par mahine
Do pie charts, ek har product ke liye
3D stacked area chart
Scatter plot jismein x product aur y revenue ho
questions.explanation: Time ke saath badlaav dikhane ke liye line chart sabse natural hai: position aur slope se trend aur seasonal ups-downs seedhe dikhte hain, aur do lines aasaani se compare hoti hain. Pie chart time ko dikha hi nahi sakta aur 24 slices padhna asambhav hai (option B). Option C tempting lag sakta hai par 3D aur stacking ke kaaran upar wali series ki values padhna mushkil ho jaata hai.

questions.question: Ek map par har state ki sales ka pichhle saal ke mukable percent change dikhana hai; values −30% se +40% tak hain. Kaunsa colour palette sabse sahi hai?
options: Rainbow palette, taaki zyada rang dikhen
Ek hue ka sequential palette (halke se gehra)
Diverging palette jiska neutral beech ka rang 0% par ho, ek taraf ghatav aur doosri taraf badhotri
Categorical palette, har state ka alag rang
questions.explanation: Yahan 0% ek meaningful midpoint hai: neeche matlab giravat, upar matlab badhotri. Diverging palette dono directions ko alag hues mein aur 0 ko neutral mein dikhata hai. Option B tempting hai par sequential palette mein −30% sirf 'halka' dikhega, giravat jaisa nahi, aur 0 ki koi pehchaan nahi hogi. Rainbow brightness ko evenly nahi badhata aur nakli boundaries banata hai, aur categorical palette ordered values ke liye galat hai.

questions.question: Ek bar chart mein do values 96 aur 98 hain, aur y-axis 95 se shuru hota hai. Chart mein doosra bar pehle bar se kitne guna lamba DIKHEGA?
options: Lagbhag 1.02 guna
2 guna
1.5 guna
3 guna
questions.explanation: Bar ki dikhne wali length axis ke start se naapi jaati hai: 96 − 95 = 1 aur 98 − 95 = 3, isliye doosra bar 3 guna lamba dikhta hai, jabki asal ratio 98 / 96 ≈ 1.02 hai. Option A asal data ka ratio hai, chart ka nahi; yahi fark truncated axis ka khatra hai. Option B ka trap values ke difference (2) ko ratio maan lena hai.

questions.question: Ek infographic mein city ki population circle ke AREA se dikhani hai. City B ki population City A se double hai. City B ke circle ka radius City A ke radius ka kitna guna hona chahiye?
options: 2 guna
Lagbhag 1.41 guna (√2)
4 guna
Utna hi; sirf rang badlo
questions.explanation: Circle ka area πr² hai, yaani radius ke square ke proportional. Area double karne ke liye r² double hona chahiye, to r ko √2 ≈ 1.41 se multiply karo. Option A sabse common jaal hai: radius double karne se area 4 guna ho jaata hai aur B ki population chaar guna jaisi dikhti hai.

questions.question: Ek line chart mein 'actual' line red aur 'target' line green hai, aur dono ek hi style ki solid lines hain. Accessibility ke liye sabse achha sudhaar kya hai?
options: Colour-blind-safe palette (jaise blue aur orange) lena, aur saath mein lines ke end par direct labels ya alag line style (solid vs dashed) dena
Red aur green ko aur zyada bright kar dena
Legend ka font bada kar dena
Chart ko 3D bana dena taaki lines alag dikhen
questions.explanation: Red-green colour difference kaafi logon ke liye mushkil hota hai, isliye meaning sirf us par nahi tikna chahiye. Safe palette ke saath ek non-colour cue (direct label, dashed line, markers) dene se chart bina colour ke bhi padha ja sakta hai. Option B tempting hai par brightness badhane se hue ka confusion nahi jaata. Option C legend padhne mein madad karta hai, par lines ko pehchaanne mein nahi; 3D clutter aur badhata hai.

questions.question: Ek report mein metric 50 se 60 hua. Graphic mein isse dikhane wale bars ki height 2 cm se 5 cm ho gayi. Lie factor (dikhaya gaya effect ÷ data ka effect, dono relative change ke roop mein) kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Graphic mein effect: (5 − 2) / 2 = 1.5, yaani 150% badhotri. Data mein effect: (60 − 50) / 50 = 0.2, yaani 20%. Lie factor = 1.5 / 0.2 = 7.5, matlab chart badlaav ko 7.5 guna bada dikhata hai (imaandaar chart mein ye 1 ke paas hota). Option A ka trap heights ka simple ratio (5 / 2) lena hai, aur option B data values ka ratio (60 / 50); dono relative CHANGE nahi naapte. Option C formula ko ulta (0.2 / 1.5) kar deta hai.

questions.question: Aapke paas 5,000 orders ke delivery times (minutes) hain, aur aap dikhana chahte ho ki zyaadatar orders kitne time mein pahunchte hain aur kitne bahut late hote hain. Sabse uchit chart kaunsa hai?
options: Pie chart, har order ka ek slice
Histogram (ya box plot) of delivery times
Line chart jismein x-axis par order number ho
Ek hi bar jo average delivery time dikhaye
questions.explanation: Sawal distribution ka hai: values kahan jama hain aur tail kitni lambi hai. Histogram bins mein ginti dikhata hai aur box plot median, IQR aur outliers; dono is sawal ka seedha jawab dete hain. Option D ka trap ek number se poori kahani batana hai; average late orders ki lambi tail chhupa deta hai. Option C order number par line kheenchta hai, jiska koi time-trend matlab nahi.

questions.question: Ek chart dikhata hai ki teesre quarter mein returns achanak badhe, aur zyaadatar size issues ki wajah se. Inmein se kaunsa title storytelling ke hisaab se sabse achha hai?
options: Returns by quarter (all product lines)
Chart 3: returns overview for the year
Quarterly returns data (all categories and regions)
Q3 mein returns 40% badhe, zyaadatar size issues se
questions.explanation: Achha title reader ko seedha insight batata hai, taaki woh chart mein use confirm kare, dhoondhe nahi. Option A aur C sirf topic batate hain; reader ko khud nikaalna padta hai ki kya important hai, aur yahi common trap hai. Option B mein koi jaankari hi nahi.

questions.question: Manager ko 5 regions ki sales ke beech chhote-chhote farak exactly compare karne hain. Encoding accuracy ke hisaab se sabse achha chart kaunsa hai?
options: Sorted bar chart, common zero baseline ke saath
Pie chart, har region ek slice
Bubble chart, har region ka ek circle
Map jismein har region ka colour intensity alag ho
questions.explanation: Insaan common scale par position aur length sabse sahi padhte hain, isliye sorted bars par chhota farak bhi saaf dikhta hai. Pie angle se, bubble area se aur map colour intensity se value dikhate hain, jo accuracy ke kram mein neeche hain; milti-julti values wahan lagbhag same lagti hain. Option B ka trap ye maanna hai ki part-to-whole hone se pie hi sahi hai; yahan sawal exact comparison ka hai.

questions.question: Ek line chart mein website ka daily response time 180 ms aur 220 ms ke beech ghoomta hai. Analyst y-axis ko 150 se 250 ms tak rakhti hai (clearly labelled). Kya ye misleading hai?
options: Haan, har chart ka axis zero se shuru hona hi chahiye
Haan, kyunki line chart mein axis hamesha 0 se 1000 tak hota hai
Nahi, line chart position aur slope dikhata hai, isliye labelled zoom theek hai
Nahi, kyunki axis kabhi bhi misleading nahi hota
questions.explanation: Zero baseline ka rule bar charts ke liye hai, kyunki wahan value LENGTH se padhi jaati hai. Line chart mein reader position aur slope dekhta hai, isliye data ki range par zoom karna jaayaz hai, agar axis clearly label ho. Option A ka trap bar chart ka rule har chart par laga dena hai. Option D galat hai: truncated bar chart ya cherry-picked range sach mein misleading hote hain.

questions.question: Ek bar chart mein 12 product categories hain aur har ek ko alag bright colour diya gaya hai. Main message sirf itna hai ki 'Snacks' category sabse tez badhi. Sabse achha sudhaar kya hai?
options: Rainbow palette lagana taaki saare 12 rang aur alag dikhen
Har bar par 3D effect aur shadow daal kar ubhaarna
Legend ko chart ke upar le jaakar bada kar dena
Baaki bars grey, sirf 'Snacks' highlight colour mein aur direct label
questions.explanation: Categorical palettes 6-8 categories ke baad pehchaan mein nahi aate, aur jab har cheez rangeen ho to kuch bhi highlight nahi hota. Ek chart, ek message: grey baaki sab, highlight sirf main category par, aur direct label se legend ki zaroorat bhi khatam. Option A ka trap 'zyada rang = zyada clarity' sochna hai; rainbow ordered data ke liye bhi kharab hai aur yahan clutter badhata hai. 3D aur legend shift message ko saaf nahi karte.

questions.question: Ek infographic mein revenue 100 se 200 hua, aur designer ne doosre circle ka RADIUS double kar diya (area se value padhi jaati hai). Lie factor (dikhaya gaya effect ÷ data ka effect, dono relative change) kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Radius double karne se area 2² = 4 guna hota hai, yaani graphic mein effect (4 − 1) / 1 = 300%. Data mein effect (200 − 100) / 100 = 100%. Lie factor = 300% / 100% = 3. Option D ka trap area ratio (4) ko hi lie factor maan lena hai; lie factor relative CHANGES ka ratio hai. Option B radius ko hi encoding samajhta hai. Sahi chart mein radius √2 guna hota aur lie factor 1.

questions.question: Bar chart mein do values 40 aur 50 hain, aur y-axis 30 se shuru hota hai. Doosra bar pehle se kitne guna lamba DIKHEGA, aur lie factor (relative changes ka ratio) kitna hai?
options: 1.25 guna; lie factor 1
2 guna; lie factor 4
2 guna; lie factor 2
1.67 guna; lie factor 4
questions.explanation: Dikhne wali lengths axis start se: 40 − 30 = 10 aur 50 − 30 = 20, to 2 guna. Graphic ka effect: (20 − 10) / 10 = 100%. Data ka effect: (50 − 40) / 40 = 25%. Lie factor = 100% / 25% = 4. Option A asal data ka ratio hai, jo zero baseline par dikhta. Option C ka trap length ratio (2) ko hi lie factor maanna hai. Option D lengths ko galat base se naapta hai.

questions.question: Chart ke liye bars ka order aur highlight colour is code se tay hote hain. Output kya hoga?
questions.code:
sales = {"North": 42, "South": 58, "East": 35, "West": 58}
order = sorted(sales, key=lambda k: (-sales[k], k))
colors = ["tab:orange" if sales[k] == max(sales.values()) else "lightgrey" for k in order]
print(order, colors.count("tab:orange"))
options: `['West', 'South', 'North', 'East'] 2`
`['South', 'West', 'North', 'East'] 1`
`['South', 'West', 'North', 'East'] 2`
`['East', 'North', 'South', 'West'] 2`
questions.explanation: Key `(-sales[k], k)` pehle value ko ghatte order mein (minus sign se) aur barabar value par naam ko alphabetical order mein lagata hai. South aur West dono 58 hain; 'South' < 'West', isliye South pehle; phir North 42, East 35. Highlight har us bar ko milta hai jiski value max (58) ke barabar ho, to tie ki wajah se 2 orange bars. Option B ka trap ye maanna hai ki max sirf ek bar ko highlight karega. Option A tie ko ulta todta hai, aur option D minus sign ko ignore karke ascending kar deta hai.

questions.question: Bubble chart mein do cities ki values 36 aur 81 hain, aur value bubble ke AREA se padhi jaani chahiye. Sahi chart mein bade bubble ka radius chhote ka kitna guna hoga? Aur agar designer galti se radius ko value ke proportional rakhe, to bada bubble area mein kitna guna dikhega?
options: Radius 2.25 guna; galat tareeke mein area 2.25 guna
Radius 1.5 guna; galat tareeke mein area 2.25 guna
Radius 2.25 guna; galat tareeke mein area 1.5 guna
Radius 1.5 guna; galat tareeke mein area ≈ 5.06 guna
questions.explanation: Data ratio 81 / 36 = 2.25. Area ∝ r², isliye area ko 2.25 guna karne ke liye radius √2.25 = 1.5 guna. Galat tareeke mein radius hi 2.25 guna ho jaata hai, to area 2.25² ≈ 5.06 guna dikhta hai, yaani asal farak ka lagbhag 2.25 guna exaggeration. Option B ka trap ye maanna hai ki radius ko value se scale karne par bhi area sahi aata hai. Options A aur C radius aur area ke rishte ko ulta kar dete hain.
